title: 55 test-bearing .zig files (incl. all 6 from ISS-0102) are wired into no build target -- found by the new tools/lint_test_wiring.py
notes: Discovered as a byproduct of GH #428 (src/engine/transition.zig's 30 in-file tests never having run). That fix's acceptance criteria required a lightweight, repo-wide check that fails when a file's test blocks are wired into no build target -- tools/lint_test_wiring.py was written to satisfy it (parses build.zig for addTest roots, resolves one level of @import indirection through shim/root files like the *_test_root.zig pattern, and reports any test-bearing .zig file under src/ or tests/ that is unreachable from every addTest root). Running that tool against the actual repo (not just transition.zig, which it now correctly reports as wired) surfaced 55 pre-existing unwired files, including all 6 files ISS-0102 (GitHub #360) already flagged by hand in 2026-07-31 (oidc09/10/11/12/15/35) plus 49 more that had never been enumerated. tools/lint_test_wiring.py's own doc comment and build.zig's `zig build test-wiring-check` step both explain why this was filed separately rather than fixed inline: fixing 55 unrelated files was out of scope for the transition.zig leak/crash fix, and wiring this check into `zig build test` today would turn the Green-Main Gate red for a pre-existing condition GH #428 did not cause. [2026-08-06T05:28:23Z] DIAGNOSIS COMPLETE (WF-03 Step 1, handoff d60e48f2): root cause is three mechanisms, not one omission -- RC-1 named-module-only production files (21 src/ files, the ungeneralised ISS-0132/GH #428 defect, incl. the fully orphaned src/repository and src/simulation trees whose mod.zig aggregators are reachable from no addTest root); RC-2 integration tests never added to tests/integration/main_test.zig's import list (12 files); RC-3 tests importing 15 named modules that are declared nowhere in build.zig, so they cannot even compile today (22 files). Per-file disposition table for all 55 files, the unit-vs-integration split protecting the Green-Main Gate, a 7-cluster implementation order, required lint_test_wiring.py changes and 5 incidental findings are in docs/issue-reports/ISS-0137-diagnosis.yaml. Totals: 350 never-executed test blocks -- 141 land on `zig build test`, 184 on `test-integration`, 25 deleted as a byte-identical duplicate (tests/unit/event_store_test_orig.zig). Status stays OPEN: no fix applied yet. [2026-08-06T05:32:56Z] SEVERITY RECLASSIFIED MINOR -> MAJOR by ORCH per diagnosis incidental finding #4: the measured gap is 350 never-executed test blocks spanning OIDC provisioning, the repository store and the simulation kernel -- not a cosmetic visibility gap. Incidental findings #3 and #5 filed separately as ISS-0147 (GH #463) and ISS-0148 (GH #464) and enqueued onto this run's issue_queue.json; findings #1 (iss206 bpm.engine_transition symbol) and #2 (exp601 relative-import escape) are in-scope for clusters C5/C6 of this run.
candidate_resolution: Route through WF-03 per logical cluster (the OIDC test files as one cluster since they likely share the main_test.zig import-list fix ISS-0102 already proposed; the src/simulation, src/repository, src/oidc production-file inline tests as separate clusters since those need a decision on whether to become their own addTest roots or be pulled into an existing aggregator per the *_test_root.zig shim pattern). For each file: either wire it in, or if it is genuinely obsolete/superseded (event_store_test_orig.zig's name suggests this), delete it or add an explicit, documented exclusion rather than leaving it silently unreachable. Re-run `python3 tools/lint_test_wiring.py` (or `zig build test-wiring-check`) after each cluster to confirm the violation count drops, and once it reaches 0, promote the check into `zig build test`'s dependency graph so this class of regression cannot recur silently. This issue's local ID is a renumbering-safe successor to (not a duplicate of) ISS-0102 / GitHub #360 -- that issue's 6 files are a strict subset of this one's 55; close #360 as superseded once this issue's own GitHub tracking issue exists, or keep both open and cross-link, per the assignee's preference.
supersedes: ISS-0102 (GitHub #360) -- ISS-0102's 6 files are a subset of this issue's 55
